item.title: Why your meeting notes app can read your meetings, and Minutesmith's can't
item.description: Most privacy claims are a policy. This one's an architecture. Minutesmith records, transcribes, and summarizes meetings entirely on your Mac, here's why that's an architectural choice, not a policy promise.
